programmes.funder: Service public de Wallonie – Économie, Emploi, Recherche (SPW EER)
programmes.amount_note: A portfolio of cheques with different rates and ceilings over a rolling three-year period ('Montant maximum sur 3 ans'), for example: Chèque Technologique up to EUR 45,000 HTVA at 50%; Chèque Propriété Intellectuelle up to EUR 45,000 at 50%; Cybersécurité up to EUR 50,000 at 75%; Maturité Numérique up to EUR 50,000 at 50%; Création-Conseil up to EUR 15,000 at 75%; Formation à la Création up to EUR 6,000 at 80%; Consultance Export up to EUR 25,000 (PME) or EUR 37,500 (starter) at 50%; Accompagnement Croissance up to EUR 50,000 at 50%.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous — cheques are requested on the platform whenever needed, subject to the three-year ceilings and available budget.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm you are a PME or independent with a principal operating seat in Wallonia and fewer than 250 employees.
Choose the cheque matching your need (technology, IP, cybersecurity, digital maturity, export, creation, growth, circular economy, energy).
Select an approved service provider and submit the request on app.cheques-entreprises.be before the service starts.
The region pays its share directly to the provider; you pay only your contribution.

documents_required.doc: Online request on the chèques-entreprises platform
Quotation/offer from an approved service provider (prestataire labellisé)
Proof of operating seat in Wallonia

eligibility.other_note: 'PME ou indépendant ... possède un siège d'exploitation principal situé en région wallonne' with fewer than 250 employees. The scheme is operated as de minimis aid under the Walloon chèques-entreprises framework; the cheque ceilings are cumulative over three years, consistent with de minimis accounting.

programmes.source_snippet: Chèque Technologique - jusqu'à 45.000 € HTVA - intervention 50% ... PME ou indépendant ... possède un siège d'exploitation principal situé en région wallonne ... Montant maximum sur 3 ans.

programmes.amount_note: '25 tot 60% van de projectbegroting', with a minimum project budget equivalent to a subsidy of EUR 100,000. No maximum is published on the page.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous submission via e-loketondernemers.be; a separate continuous defence call runs in 2026.

procedure_steps.detail: Define a research project that builds up the company's research and development capability.
Ensure the project budget is large enough to reach the EUR 100,000 minimum subsidy.

documents_required.doc: Research project proposal with scientific/technical description
Valorisation plan for the Flemish economy

eligibility.other_note: 'Onderneming actief in het Vlaamse Gewest'. Higher rates (up to 60%) apply to SMEs and collaborative research.

programmes.source_snippet: 25 tot 60% van de projectbegroting ... een minimumbegroting equivalent aan een subsidie van € 100.000 ... Onderneming actief in het Vlaamse Gewest.

programmes.amount_note: '25 tot 50%' of project costs for SMEs, with a minimum subsidy of EUR 25,000 and a maximum of EUR 3 million.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous submission via het e-loket voor ondernemers. A separate 'continue oproep defensie 2026' exists for defence-related projects.

procedure_steps.detail: Define a development project: developing new technologies, improving processes, building prototypes or running pilot phases.
Discuss the project with a VLAIO adviser and prepare the project and cost plan.
Submit digitally through e-loketondernemers.be; VLAIO evaluates and decides.

documents_required.doc: Project proposal with technical description and valorisation plan

eligibility.other_note: Companies with an operating seat in the Flemish Region. Grant rate 25-50% for SMEs depending on project type and company size.

programmes.source_snippet: 25 tot 50% van de projectkosten voor kmo's ... minimum steun € 25.000 ... maximum steun € 3 miljoen.
